articles.headline: Antetokounmpo scores 34, Heat block 14 shots and roll past Pistons 137-117 for 4th straight win
articles.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 34 points, 14 rebounds and eight assists, some of the spectacular variety, and the Miami Heat beat the Detroit...
articles.headlineJa: アデトクンボが34得点、ヒートは14本のブロックを記録しピストンズを137-117で快勝、4連勝
articles.descriptionJa: — ヤニス・アデトクンボは34得点、14リバウンド、8アシストを記録し、多彩で華麗なプレーを披露。マイアミ・ヒートはデトロイトを...
articles.body:
MIAMI -- — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 34 points, 14 rebounds and eight assists, some of the spectacular variety, and the Miami Heat beat the Detroit Pistons 137-117 on Saturday night for their fourth straight win.


              Klay Thompson scored 26 points in his return from a sprained ankle and Bam Adebayo added 20 for the Heat. Davion Mitchell had 15 points and nine rebounds for Miami.


              Cade Cunningham had 33 points and eight assists for Detroit, which got 20 points and seven assists from Kevin Huerter.


              Miami had nine players record at least one block and finished with 14 as a team — one shy of the franchise record.


              The NBA record for players on the same team having at least one block in a game is 10, done twice — both by Golden State, first in 1991 and then again in 2016. The Heat team record for players with at least one block was eight, done on five occasions.


              Antetokounmpo finished a weekend where he scored 71 points in a two-day span, after finishing with 37 in Miami's win over Cleveland on Friday night. He also had a through-the-legs assist to Thompson for a 3-pointer in the opening quarter.


              It was one of six 3s on the night for Thompson, who is now 26 away from tying former Heat guard Ray Allen (2,973) for the third-most 3-pointers in NBA history.


              Miami won for the seventh time in its last nine games and became the fourth team in the last 25 seasons to start 0-4 but rally to a winning record at the 13-game mark. Sacramento (7-6) did it in 2022-23, Oklahoma City (8-5) did it in 2018-19 and Dallas (9-4) did it in 2006-07.


              It also matched the best nine-game stretch for the Heat since an 8-1 burst in November 2023.


              Up next
              Pistons: Visit San Antonio on Tuesday night.


              Heat: Host Houston on Monday night.


              ------

articles.headline: Cedric Coward has 23 points and 12 rebounds as Grizzlies beat Nets 129-110
articles.description: — Cedric Coward had 23 points and 12 rebounds and Taylor Hendricks scored a career-high 22 as Memphis built an early lead and defeated the Brooklyn Nets 129-110 on Saturday night.
articles.headlineJa: セドリック・コワードが23得点12リバウンドを記録、グリズリーズがネッツに129-110で勝利
articles.descriptionJa: セドリック・コワードが23得点12リバウンド、テイラー・ヘンドリックスがキャリアハイの22得点を挙げたメンフィスが序盤に主導権を握り、土曜夜にブルックリン・ネッツを129-110で下した。
articles.body:
MEMPHIS, Tenn. -- — Cedric Coward had 23 points and 12 rebounds and Taylor Hendricks scored a career-high 22 as Memphis built an early lead and defeated the Brooklyn Nets 129-110 on Saturday night.


              A night after a 142-111 victory over New Orleans featured 10 Memphis players reaching double figures, tying an NBA record, seven Grizzlies reached double figures against the Nets. Javon Small scored 19 and Cam Spencer finished with 17 and eight assists as Memphis won its third in the last four.


              Julius Randle lead Brooklyn with 22 points and Day’Ron Sharpe added 16 points and 11 rebounds as Brooklyn lost its third in the last four. Noah Clowney scored 15.


              Memphis built a 20-point first-half lead behind 3-point success and weathered a third quarter Brooklyn burst that cut the advantage to single digits. By early in the fourth quarter, Memphis had taken the lead back to 24.


              Both teams had to overcome travel issues out of New Orleans that plagued the country during Friday's grounding of planes. The Nets stayed over after playing New Orleans on Wednesday; the Grizzlies beat the Pelicans on Friday night.


              The teams arrived midday Saturday only hours before tipoff. That led to compressed game preparation.


              Then Brooklyn's leading scorer and rebounder Michael Porter Jr. was a late scratch for personal reasons, eliminating 21.5 points and 7.5 rebounds from the Nets arsenal. The Grizzlies were without starters Ty Jerome, the team's leading scorer, and center Zach Edey.


              Memphis built an early double-digit lead behind starting 9 of 11 from 3-point range. The Nets shooting would improve in the second quarter, but Spencer's 3-pointer as time expired in the second — their 13th of the half — gave Memphis a 71-54 lead at the break.


              Up next
              Nets: Host Philadelphia on Monday.


              Grizzlies: At Wahington on Monday.


              ------

articles.headline: Patriots place RB TreVeyon Henderson on IR with still unexplained illness
articles.description: The Patriots placed RB TreVeyon Henderson on injured reserve while he deals with an unexplained neurological issue.
articles.headlineJa: ペイトリオッツ、原因不明の病気によりRBトレヴェヨン・ヘンダーソンをIRに登録
articles.descriptionJa: ペイトリオッツは、原因不明の神経系の問題に直面しているRBトレヴェヨン・ヘンダーソンを負傷者リスト（IR）に登録した。
articles.body:
MUNICH -- The New England Patriots placed running back TreVeyon Henderson on injured reserve Saturday, eight days after Henderson said he recently experienced "an unexpected and unusual medical emergency involving a series of unexplained neurological symptoms."

Henderson had already been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions at FC Bayern Munich Arena (9:30 a.m. ET, Fox) earlier in the week. He now will miss at least the next four games.

Henderson has said that tests have "come back positive and reassuring," and in a social media post said, "the cause of this remains unknown and unexplainable."

 

The Patriots entered the week with just two healthy running backs -- Corey Kiner and Lan Larison -- as starter Rhamondre Stevenson was managing a knee tendon injury sustained in last Sunday's loss to the Packers.

Stevenson was a limited participant in the Patriots' two practices in Munich, and coach Mike Vrabel said Friday he was feeling "pretty good" when asked to gauge Stevenson's potential availability for the game at that point. Vrabel said the same thing about wide receiver A.J. Brown, who has missed the past two games with a knee flare-up.

A potential tipoff that Stevenson could be active for Sunday's game against the Lions came when Saturday's deadline to elevate players from the practice squad passed and the Patriots didn't elevate a running back. Going into a game with just two running backs would be outside the norm, as most teams have at least three.

In other roster moves, the Patriots activated center/guard Greg Van Roten and fullback Reggie Gilliam to the active roster from injured reserve, and elevated center/guard Andrew Rupcich from the practice squad for Sunday's game.

articles.headlineJa: DraftKings DFSチートシート：日曜メインスレートのベストバリュー
articles.descriptionJa: 最適なスタックとバリューを特定したDraftKings NFL第10週チートシートで、勝利を掴むDFSラインナップを構築しよう。
articles.body:
Every week, we evaluate all of your DraftKings options to identify the best values among the lower-priced options, as well as the matchups to play or avoid, so you can select the players who are worth their high price tags. This week's best values include both Josh Allen and James Cook III against the New York Jets, Kenneth Walker III against the Atlanta Falcons and this may be the last time you get to roster Justin Jefferson at less that $7000 this season now that he's been reunited with Kirk Cousins.

Value is determined by the number of DraftKings points you can expect for every dollar invested in putting that player in your lineup. A player may be an "Average" or even a "Good" value while also projected to outscore a player identified as a "great value," but when you consider the cap hit and the salary you can put towards other players, you may decide that the "Great" value outweighs that projection.

Players considered to be a "Great" value are those in the 90th percentile of projected value picks for the week. "Good" plays are in the 75th percentile or better. "Average" plays span the 25th to 74th percentiles, while "Shaky" plays are in the 10th-24th percentiles. "Poor" picks encompass single-digit percentiles. Only players projected to score 4 points or more are displayed.

Player salaries are drawn from DraftKings' main slate and are based on the ESPN player projections at the time of publication.

articles.headline: Saints RB Travis Etienne Jr. activated off IR for game vs. Panthers
articles.description: The New Orleans Saints activated running back Travis Etienne Jr. off injured reserve prior to their game against the Carolina Panthers, the team announced Saturday.
articles.headlineJa: セインツのRBトラビス・エティエンヌ・ジュニア、パンサーズ戦に向けてIRから復帰
articles.descriptionJa: ニューオーリンズ・セインツは土曜日、カロライナ・パンサーズとの試合を前に、ランニングバックのトラビス・エティエンヌ・ジュニアを負傷者リスト（IR）から復帰させたと発表した。
articles.body:
NEW ORLEANS -- The New Orleans Saints activated running back Travis Etienne Jr. off injured reserve prior to their game against the Carolina Panthers, the team announced Saturday.

Etienne has been on IR since Oct. 1, following a hamstring injury that occurred in a Week 3 game against the Las Vegas Raiders.

Etienne had been dealing with hamstring issues in the week leading up to the Raiders game. Though he rushed for a season-high 57 yards, he left the game in the third quarter after grabbing his left hamstring at the end of a 16-yard run.

Etienne said he "feels great," and said he was eager to return after practicing fully on Friday.

"I definitely want to, but I mean, whatever they require me, what I'm going to do. So I'm just here to help the team and I feel like not much help when I'm out there on the sideline in my street clothes. So hopefully it let me suit up and I go out there and just be a valuable asset to the team," he said.

Etienne will likely share carries with Alvin Kamara and Audric Estime, who led the team with 72 rushing yards vs. the Cleveland Browns last week after being claimed off waivers.

The Saints also placed second-round pick Christen Miller on IR after he was downgraded earlier in the week with a knee injury. They will be without two starting offensive linemen against the Panthers as Erik McCoy (biceps) and Taliese Fuaga (knee) were both declared out Friday.

articles.headline: 'Extremely lucky' Declan Rice hints new Arsenal contract will be signed soon
articles.description: Declan Rice has hinted he is likely to sign a new contract at Arsenal to extend his stay at the club beyond 2028.
articles.headlineJa: 「非常に幸運だ」デクラン・ライス、アーセナルとの新契約締結が間近であることを示唆
articles.descriptionJa: デクラン・ライスは、アーセナルでの残留期間を2028年以降に延長するため、クラブと新たな契約を締結する可能性が高いことを示唆した。
articles.body:
MADRID -- Declan Rice has hinted he is likely to sign a new contract at Arsenal to extend his stay at the club beyond 2028.

The 27-year-old joined the Gunners from West Ham for £105 million in 2023 and his current deal expires at the end of next season, although the club have an option to extend by a further year.

- Tuchel plays down racism row ahead of England's clash in Spain

- England have come a long way since World Cup heartbreak. But are they ready for Spain?

- What do England need vs. Spain, why does it matter, and who's next? 

Sources have told ESPN that talks have taken place across several months and Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta has said it is "a matter of time" before Rice commits his future to the club.

The midfielder expressed his desire to stay at the Premier League champions when addressing media ahead of England's Nations League clash with Spain in Madrid.

"I've been extremely lucky that I've managed to play at such a consistent level throughout my career," said Rice.

"I'm a player that always sets myself targets, always pushes for more. I've always been stable in the clubs I'm at. New contract hopefully on the horizon soon.

"I'm extremely lucky I'm at a club like Arsenal where the manager shows me so much trust, I've so many teammates who put so much energy and effort into me. I'm extremely lucky that I don't have to worry about that stuff. It makes playing football a lot easier."

Rice hopes England can emulate Arsenal's recent progress in overcoming years of underachievement to win the Premier League for the first time in 22 years and reaching last season's Champions League Final for only the second time in the club's history.

"What the manager has installed in us at Arsenal is to not have any fear," Rice said. "The progression in the Champions League over the last three years -- quarterfinal, semifinal, final -- coming to this stadium last year, we've been to the Bernabeu, Bayern Munich.

"The Arsenal of old may have struggled in those stadiums. Playing in that team now, putting on that shirt before that game, you know what you're going to get before you go out there.

"You're going to get a strong team, togetherness, we're going to run for each other, we're going to play forward, So I'm extremely lucky at the minute that I'm in a beautiful team with such great players and with a manager who is leading us and with players who listen to him and follows all his instructions. It is no surprise we're on the trajectory we're on at the minute. Long may it continue.

articles.headline: Steelers activate DT Derrick Harmon from IR ahead of key Bengals clash
articles.description: The Steelers have activated defensive tackle Derrick Harmon from injured reserve after he missed the past four games with a foot injury.
articles.headlineJa: スティールズ、ベンガルズとの重要な一戦を前にDTデリック・ハーモンをIRから復帰
articles.descriptionJa: スティールズは、足の怪我で過去4試合を欠場していたディフェンシブタックルのデリック・ハーモンを、故障者リスト（IR）から復帰させた。
articles.body:
The Pittsburgh Steelers have activated defensive tackle Derrick Harmon from injured reserve after he missed the past four games with a foot injury.

Harmon was carted off the field after suffering the injury Oct. 1 against the Cleveland Browns. A source had told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport at the time that the Steelers did not consider Harmon to have a long-term injury, and he was activated following Pittsburgh's bye after missing the minimum of four games.

The 23-year-old Harmon was Pittsburgh's first-round draft selection last year, and he recorded 27 tackles and three sacks in 2025 as a rookie.

He had the game-winning strip sack of Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow in Pittsburgh's Week 3 victory over Cincinnati. Those teams will face off again this week on "Sunday Night Football," with Harmon listed as questionable.

Harmon was listed as a full participant in Friday's walk-through after being limited in the first two practices of the week.

"Just make sure my foot feels good," Harmon said Friday of his goals for the week of practice, adding that he thought he accomplished them. "I can still strike blocks, and I got the playbook down, of course, but still just fine-tuning that part of things."

In a corresponding move Saturday, the Steelers waived cornerback Terell Smith.

ESPN's Brooke Pryor contributed to this report.

articles.headline: DE Danielle Hunter, LB Azeez Al-Shaair among Texans ruled out vs. Browns
articles.description: The Texans will be without a number of key starters -- including running back David Montgomery and All-Pro defensive end Danielle Hunter -- when they travel to face the Browns.
articles.headlineJa: テキサンズ、ブラウンズ戦にDEダニエル・ハンターとLBアジーズ・アルシャアールらが出場せず
articles.descriptionJa: ブラウンズ戦に乗り込むテキサンズは、ランニングバックのデヴィッド・モントゴメリーやオールプロのディフェンシブエンド、ダニエル・ハンターを含む多くの主力選手を欠くことになる。
articles.body:
HOUSTON -- The Texans will be without a number of key starters when they travel to face the Browns on Sunday.

On defense, the Texans will not have All-Pro defensive end Danielle Hunter (hamstring) and Pro Bowl linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair (groin).

Hunter has four sacks this season, tied for second on the Texans. Al-Shaair has dealt with a groin injury dating back to Week 3 against the Indianapolis Colts and missed Week 4 against the Dallas Cowboys. He leads the Texans in tackles (68) and wears the green dot for the defense.

On Saturday, running back David Montgomery joined the list of Texans players ruled out. Montgomery injured his groin against the Tennessee Titans and hasn't played in a game since Week 5. He did practice this week, which is progress.

Other notable players ruled out are rookie guard Keylan Rutledge (shoulder) and recently traded for wideout Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring), who has six receptions for 60 yards and a touchdown over three games in Houston.

articles.headline: Mauricio Pochettino to Man United: Is Tottenham love affair finally over?
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino is back in the Premier League as the new Man United boss. For Tottenham fans, it's complicated.
articles.headlineJa: マウリシオ・ポチェッティーノがマンUへ：トッテナムとの愛の物語はついに終わるのか？
articles.descriptionJa: マウリシオ・ポチェッティーノがマンチェスター・ユナイテッドの新監督としてプレミアリーグに復帰します。トッテナムのファンにとっては、複雑な心境となるでしょう。
articles.body:
"He's magic, you know, Mauricio Pochettino!" For five years, these were the words that rang out amongst Tottenham fans.

First, at the old White Hart Lane -- a much-loved, if dilapidated, ground that became a fortress during Pochettino's years as head coach of the club. Then, at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium -- a magnificent arena that, in recent years, has felt more like a house of horrors than any sort of stronghold.

But now Pochettino is back in the Premier League, this time as Manchester United manager. And for Tottenham fans who once dreamed of seeing the Argentine return to north London, it's another reminder that the man who gave us so many unforgettable memories might never be coming home.

The Pochettino love affair

The Argentine manager joined Tottenham in 2014 and was at the helm of one of the best, and most beloved, Spurs teams in the club's history. Under Pochettino, Harry Kane (now a Ballon d'Or winner!), Son Heung-Min, Christian Eriksen, Dele Alli, Jan Vertonghen, Toby Alderweireld, Mousa Dembélé and Hugo Lloris all shone in ways that few football fans and pundits expected.

During the Pochettino era, Tottenham came agonisingly close to winning the Premier League and reached the Champions League final. They went an entire season unbeaten at home -- somewhat unthinkable now given the team's struggles at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium -- and played some of the most thrilling football in the league at the time.

There were famous victories over arch-rivals Arsenal and in Europe, including over Real Madrid and Borussia Dortmund, and, of course, there was that night in Amsterdam. When Lucas Moura scored an astonishing hat trick against Ajax to send Spurs to the Champions League final for the first time in our history.

For many Spurs fans, including myself, the Poch years brought some of our best ever memories of supporting the club. There was a special connection between Pochettino and fans. He was revered and many of us hoped that it would last forever -- even if we all knew that, really, nothing ever lasts that long. Especially not in football.

When Pochettino was sacked, rather unceremoniously, in November 2019 -- just months after taking us to the Champions League final -- it felt somewhat unjust.

It was clear for anyone to see in 2019 that Tottenham's squad was beginning to get stale in a number of areas and that what the club truly needed was a rebuild. For myriad reasons, that never came to fruition and so, when, results on the pitch took a nosedive in the winter of that year the axe fell on Pochettino.

Overnight, the man who had turned Tottenham into a truly formidable side capable of beating anyone on their day was gone. Since then, it's fair to say that no other manager that has taken the wheel at the club has managed to form the same sort of bond that Pochettino had with us.

Many have come and gone but it hasn't yet felt like any of them have "got" us the way that Pochettino did. It is early days under Roberto De Zerbi

articles.headlineJa: マンチェスター・ユナイテッド、今季の不調から紐解くポチェッティーノの課題リスト
articles.descriptionJa: ポチェッティーノはマンチェスター・ユナイテッドの監督に就任するのにふさわしい人物の一人だが、次は何をすべきか。彼が引き継ぐ混乱した状況と、最優先課題について考察する。
articles.body:
What has been your favorite mind-boggling decision of Manchester United's lost era? Mine was when they hired Ralf Rangnick to establish modern pressing-and-possession principles for half a season ... three months after signing Cristiano Ronaldo, the most anti-pressing-and-possession star of the modern era. Shockingly, it wasted everyone's time (though Rangnick still averaged more points per game than Ruben Amorim).

Given everything we've learned about running a properly functional soccer club in the 2020s, it's nice to have a strong "Don't be like [insert club name here]" at which to point.

You're supposed to use your front office to establish the direction and identity of the club, then hire the coach to follow that identity; the era of the "Great Man" manager is over. But Manchester United, the club that owes its modern success (and valuation) to the greatest Great Man manager of the past 50 years (Sir Alex Ferguson), can't help but search for the next Fergie at all times.

You aren't supposed to constantly hire the stylistic opposite of your ex, especially if you're giving the new hire too much power over player acquisitions: If you do, you'll end up with a squad of mishmashed parts acquired for all sorts of different purposes. But that seems to be all Manchester United know to do. They lurched from the defense-and-counter David Moyes to the ultracautious, all-possession Louis van Gaal, back to the mostly negative Jose Mourinho, then to the positive (and probably too adaptive) Ole Gunnar Solskjaer.

- Ogden: Man United have finally hired a proper manager

- Dawson: How Carrick won the Man United job and lost it again

- Carlisle: Pochettino leaves USMNT with job half-finished

After briefly failing with Rangnick's gegenpressing, they asked Erik ten Hag to find some middle ground between possession and defense. When this shockingly proved difficult, they asked Ruben Amorim, with his rigid 3-5-2 formation, to do the same. Just as he was establishing strong underlying numbers and advanced stats -- another aspect that successful modern clubs long ago began to rely on, including a Brentford team that spends infinitely less than United and earned more points over the past 2½ seasons -- Amorim was pushed out the door in favor of another favorite son, Michael Carrick.

Now Carrick's gone, too.

The tenures are getting shorter and shorter, the wins fewer and further between.

Throw in Rangnick's unhappy time (1.48 PPG) as half-season interim between Solskjaer and ten Hag, and three of the four shortest and least successful United tenures have come in the past four hires (and five years). Shockingly, returns diminish when you never establish a plan, and the initial rumored candidates list for replacing Carrick -- the passion-and-pressing Mauricio Pochettino, the far more defensive Antonio Conte and Eddie Howe, the almost van Gaal-like Julian Nagelsmann -- didn't exactly hint at a clear plan this time around, either.

articles.descriptionJa: レアル・マドリードはバイエルン・ミュンヘンのスター、マイケル・オリーズへの関心を維持している。Transfer Talkが最新情報をお届けする。
articles.body:
Bayern Munich star Michael Olise is still being tailed by Real Madrid, while United States internationals Folarin Balogun and Alex Freeman could be following coach Mauricio Pochettino to Manchester United. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Real Madrid remain interested in Bayern Munich winger Michael Olise, after previously being linked with him during the summer, according to L'Equipe. The 24-year-old is reported to have multiple top clubs in Europe 'dreaming' of signing him next summer, when he will enter the final two years of his contract at the Allianz Arena. Olise scored in France's 3-1 Nations League defeat against Italy on Thursday.

- Manchester United have added United States duo Folarin Balogun and Alex Freeman to their list, TEAMtalk reports. Monaco striker Balogun, 25, and Villarreal defender Freeman, 22, are seen as two ideal candidates to land in January due to their familiarity with the USMNT coach Mauricio Pochettino. It was announced on Friday that Pochettino has agreed a deal to become the next manager at United and replace the fired Michael Carrick at Old Trafford. The Red Devils have been monitoring Freeman for some time, but could now step up their interest following his impressive performances under Pochettino for the USMNT. Balogun has said that he will look to seal a move away from Monaco in the next transfer window, having seen his proposed move to Everton fall through in the summer.

- Liverpool are keen on Brighton & Hove Albion defender Luka Vuskovic, Florian Plettenberg reports. The Reds are monitoring the 19-year-old regularly after placing him on their shortlist of options for next summer, and he could be seen as a potential long term successor to Virgil van Dijk, who is yet to sign an extension on his current deal which is set to expire in June. There is no release clause in Vuskovic's contract, with his transfer expected to require a proposal worth in the region of €100 million.

- Chelsea right back Malo Gusto is attracting interest from Manchester City and Manchester United, according to talkSPORT. Both clubs are keeping tabs on the situation of the 23-year-old, who has only made three starts in the Premier League this season. The Blues would demand an offer worth £75 million before agreeing to part ways with him, in a deal that could see Gusto reunite with former manager Enzo Maresca at the Etihad Stadium.

- Juventus are interested in Tottenham Hotspur's Destiny Udogie and Barcelona's Alejandro Balde as new left backs,according to Corriere dello Sport. Udogie, 23, has made just two starts in the Premier League this season as the second choice option to Andy Robertson, and he has been identified as a player that the Bianconeri could acquire to reinforce the left side of their defense in January. Balde, 23, has also struggled to garner first team minutes and is linked with an exit from Camp Nou.
